violation_type.title: Positive Methods of Discipline and Guidance - Brief Supervised Separation (26 TAC §746.2803(4)(D))
violation_type.short_title: Positive Methods of Discipline and Guidance - Brief Supervised Separation
violation_type.typical_finding: A child was put in time out three times during a day, the time out exceeded the appropriated time recommended for the child's age and understanding level.

finding_variants.text: A child was put in time out three times during a day, the time out exceeded the appropriated time recommended for the child's age and understanding level.
It was discovered that a 2 year old caregiver was placing children in timeout for 5-10 minutes.

Based on the evidence gathered it can be determined that a three year old was placed in supervised separation for ten minutes. Brief supervised separation time is limited to no more than one minute per year of the child?s age.
A total of 3 caregivers stated they will separate the child from group as discipline for more than the allowed time (usually 1-2 minutes more).
Based on the evidence obtained during the investigation, a child was separated from the group for discipline for more than a minute per the child's age.

This standard was tasked over for this investigation and found to be deficient. The child involved in this incident was observed left in time out for more than the allowed number of minutes based on his age of 2 years; more than 2 minutes.
